title: Randomized value and multilinear extension
statement: Let $P$ be a Boolean predicate on $m$ signs and let $\mu\in[-1,1]^m$. The probability that $P$ accepts independent random signs whose respective means are the coordinates of $\mu$ equals the multilinear extension of $P$ evaluated at $\mu$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean predicate on a finite number $m$ of signs
